description: A coordinated disinformation campaign using synthetic media overwhelms local fact-checking capacity in three member states ahead of regional elections, causing widespread confusion and delayed vote certification. The attack exploits open-weight models at capability 50 and is traced to a novel adversarial training method that evades existing detection. Public trust in digital institutions erodes further.

A major European AI research lab announces a breakthrough in distillation techniques, enabling models at 58–60 capability to be run efficiently on commodity hardware. This dramatically widens access to near-frontier capability outside controlled environments, increasing misuse risk. The development is independent of current policy measures but accelerates openweight proliferation trends.
